title.en: An Act Converting the Sitios of Turod, Paco, Calamagui and Kim-Malabasa in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Isabela, into Barrios

text.en: The sitios of Turod, Paco, Calamagui and Kim-malabasa in the Municipality of Magsaysay, Province of Isabela, are hereby converted into barrios.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 24, 1959.
